p: fair: Because Christ delights in his Church, he commends all that is in her.
flock of goats: He has respect for the multitude of the faithful, which are many in number.
breasts are like two young roes: In which are knowledge and zeal two precious jewels.
Come with me from Lebanon: Christ promises his Church to call his faithful from all the corners of the world.
sister: Christ calls his Church sister in respect that he had taken the flesh of man.
eyes: In that he made his Church beautiful and rich, he loved his gifts in her.
lips: Because of your confession and thanksgiving.
A fountain of gardens: The Church confesses that all her glory and beauty comes from Christ who is the true fountain of all grace.
north wind: She desires Christ to comfort her and to pour the graces of his Spirit on her, which is meant by the North and South wind.
